notes: 1907 three-storey flats, flat ochre-yellow stucco with cream trim. Two sash windows per upper storey, three small pilaster brackets under a plain cornice. Ground storey: a barred gate-door left, a small gated window, a sash window right. No bays. Applied: ochre-yellow stucco with cream trim, paired windows (two sashes side by side) in two bays each upper storey, stronger bracketed cornice with frieze, iron lattice entry gate (the vertical-bar gate swapped). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. More saturated ochre tint, wider sash windows, taller brackets. SKIPPED third upper storey: the ground (4.8 m, gate door plus the high window) and two upper window rows, matching the data. Lifted/converted once to #fff0b8.
